title: AI-Savvy Graphic & Web Designer for Biotechnology Website Modernization
description:
**Company:** 
 BioGenex Life Sciences / OmicsVeu
   

**Department:** 
 Marketing / Digital Design
   

**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time / Project\-based
   

**Industry:** 
 Biotechnology \| Life Sciences \| Diagnostics \| Precision Oncology
   


  

  




 About the Role
   

  

  


 BioGenex and OmicsVeu are looking for a creative and technically strong
 **Graphic \& Web Designer** 
 to modernize our biotechnology and precision\-oncology websites.
   





 The ideal candidate should combine
 **UI/UX design, graphic design, website development and AI\-powered design tools** 
 to transform complex scientific information into modern, engaging and commercially effective digital experiences.
   

  




 Key Responsibilities
   

  

  

* Review and modernize BioGenex and OmicsVeu websites.
* Develop website architecture, sitemaps, navigation, wireframes and responsive page designs.
* Create high\-quality UI/UX designs using
 **Figma** 
 .
* Design scientific workflow graphics, product diagrams, icons, infographics and illustrations.
* Improve product, application, publication and lead\-generation pages.
* Build or support website implementation using
 **Web\-flow, WordPress or similar platforms** 
 .
* Create brochures, presentations and digital marketing assets aligned with the brand.
* Develop reusable design templates and component libraries.
* Optimize websites for
 **SEO, speed, accessibility, responsiveness and lead generation** 
 .
* Use AI tools such as
 **ChatGPT, Adobe Firefly, Canva, Relume or similar platforms** 
 to accelerate research, ideation and design while maintaining originality and accuracy.
* Maintain editable source files, design systems and organized project documentation.


 Requirements
   

  

  

 Required Experience \& Skills
   

  

  

* Strong portfolio of modern corporate, product or technology websites.
* Strong
 **Graphic Design and UI/UX Design** 
 capabilities.
* Hands\-on experience with
 **Figma and Adobe Creative Suite** 
 .
* Experience with
 **Web\-flow and/or WordPress** 
 .
* Ability to create infographics, product illustrations and technical/scientific graphics.
* Understanding of responsive web design, SEO and website optimization.
* Strong visual storytelling and brand\-design skills.
* Hands\-on experience using AI tools for design and content workflows.
* Excellent written and spoken English.
* Ability to manage projects independently and meet deadlines.
* Biotechnology, Healthcare, Diagnostics, Medical Devices or Life Sciences design experience is preferred.


 Candidate Assessment
   

  

  


 Shortlisted candidates may be asked to complete a
 **paid design assignment** 
 involving the redesign of a key homepage or product page.
   





 Candidates should be prepared to share at the final stage of the application process with drive links:
   




* Relevant website portfolio.
* Examples of graphics, brochures, infographics or technical diagrams.
* Preferred website platform and approach.
* Experience using AI tools in design workflows.
* Project availability and expected compensation.
* Confirmation of ability to provide editable source files.



 Successful performance may lead to continued website, graphic\-design and digital\-marketing projects.
   

  

  

  




 Benefits
   

  

* 5 Day Work Week
* Bus Facility
* Health Insurance
* Provident Fund
* Leave Encashment
